content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈193.0789 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₁H₁₃O₃ (the calculated monoisotopic mass is 193.0865 Da, within typical experimental error and consistent with the observed M+1 isotopic peak at 195.0896 Da). Therefore, the molecular formula is C11H13O3.
